title: Research theorem: sharp scratch-dependent call bound for dirty echoes
body:
Proves a sharp call bound for ordered dirty-echo trees: `N >= 2^(s+1)n - 4^s`, with an explicit attaining family for every `s >= 2` and `3*2^(s-2) <= n <= 2^s`. In particular, 50 factors with six arbitrary dirty arrays have exact minimum **2,304 complete leaf calls**, versus 2,752 for the pinned balanced binary word. All inverse and restoration work is included.

**Status: research note / independent verification; no new kappa.** The theorem is scoped to static ordered echo trees with reserved parent scratch. It is not a minimum over arbitrary reversible programs or a multiplication improvement.

Concurrent #758 already supplies all-arity weighted optimization; #730 supplies mixed binary/ternary optimization and #744 a strict-ternary audit. This contribution credits them and adds the analytic scratch-dependent bound and equality family. Its independent uniform-cost implementation also corroborates #758 at nine pinned instances. The echo itself is #673's, the stronger balanced comparator is #689's, and the rounded leaves are #628's.

[Proof](https://github.com/AlexS-scale/integer-mult-bounds/blob/548e42022b37a300f8bf745e848c38baccbce056/research/dirty-echo-space-budget/PROOF.md) · [Exact certificate](https://github.com/AlexS-scale/integer-mult-bounds/blob/548e42022b37a300f8bf745e848c38baccbce056/research/dirty-echo-space-budget/EXPECTED.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/AlexS-scale/integer-mult-bounds/blob/548e42022b37a300f8bf745e848c38baccbce056/research/dirty-echo-space-budget/SOURCES.json) · [Validation](https://github.com/AlexS-scale/integer-mult-bounds/blob/548e42022b37a300f8bf745e848c38baccbce056/research/dirty-echo-space-budget/VALIDATION.md)

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/dirty-echo-space-budget/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_DIRTY_ECHO_SPACE_BUDGET: n=50, arrays=6, leaves=2752->2304`.

Validation passes on macOS arm64 / Python **3.11.15 and 3.14.7**:

- All 576 declared states, 255 literal witnesses, 5,440 independently enumerated small trees, and 36 explicit equality-family constructions.
- 2,904 signed noncommutative identities/inverse checks, 1,530 nonlinear round trips, and 186 rounded compositions with dense exact references and counted phase reads.
- Instruction and interface negative controls, relocated replay, seven artifact-corruption/overwrite controls, 13 exact Git source bindings, and selected-record integrity.

One isolated `make verify` completed seven historical groups, then stopped at `gen4-bank-verify` because SymPy is absent. No full-suite, supplier cold-replay, remote CI, Lean or independent human-review pass is claimed.

Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. OS assignment seed **50**, recursive interfaces. Initial claim was local because no pinned coordination issue existed. Final full refresh covered 586 open PRs through #767; the immediate pre-submission check covered arrivals through #782. PR673 advanced to `b3917936aafbd0d680a954a86e25c4ce7e28a9f9`; both consumed files remain byte-identical to the pinned head. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Prepared by **Alexander Schwartzman (@AlexS-scale)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, under Apache-2.0. Source notices and concurrent credit are retained. Uniform/compiler, physical hosting, precision, tape and analytic obligations remain inherited; finite replay is not a formal proof of the multiplication theorem.
